explication: My IELTS is a browser-based IELTS study resource. Learners navigate subject sections and use their material directly: vocabulary browsing/typing and audio, grammar resources, listening strategy and practice, reading keyword substitutions, writing translation exercises, and speaking (currently marked TODO). The Vue entry point installs hash-based routing, while the shared shell renders the selected page. README capability descriptions supplement the sampled pages; wiring details for unsampled pages are represented only at their existing paths.
